title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
author: Oscar Wilde
summary: A beautiful young man wishes he could stay young while his portrait ages. Under the influence of the witty Lord Henry, he pursues pleasure with no concern for consequence.
readIf: you like sparkling epigrams and a gothic story about vanity and corruption.
skipIf: you dislike long, talky passages or morally unredeemed characters.

pairings.reason: Another short Victorian tale about respectability hiding a darker nature.
A modern novel in which an elite, charming circle slides into moral ruin.
A classic about the cost of tampering with nature, with a more sympathetic creation.
